  LEFT JOIN ratings AS r ON r.movie_id = m.movie_id

  GROUP BY m.movie_id, m.movie_title
)

       average_popularity,
       five_rating_scores,

FROM nolan

WITH nolan_movies AS (
    SELECT m.movie_id, m.movie_title, AVG(m.movie_popularity) AS average_popularity,
           SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS five_rating_scores
    FROM movies AS m
    LEFT JOIN ratings AS r ON r.movie_id = m.movie_id
    WHERE m.director_name = 'Christopher Nolan'
    GROUP BY m.movie_id, m.movie_title
), ranked AS (
    SELECT nolan_movies.*,
           MAX(five_rating_scores) OVER () AS max_five_rating_scores
    FROM nolan_movies
)
SELECT movie_title, average_popularity, five_rating_scores,
       CASE WHEN five_rating_scores = max_five_rating_scores THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS highest_number_of_5_rating_scores
FROM ranked
ORDER BY movie_title;
